items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Especially the ones that are marked from Sidney Desveen.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you how... I don't know whether... How did Ramsey and Smith... It says edited by Frederick Ramsey Jr. and Charles Edward Smith. Did they go through the whole book and decide which was going in and which was going left out?

No, that was all decided before. Actually, another funny thing was I don't even have my contract to prove it anymore. There were four editors, supposedly. Steve Smith and I were also listed as editors in the original contract and the idea was that we got a bigger... a bigger share of the advance or something by being an editor that way. We got more money to work with... I guess some of the others didn't even get $30 maybe. I don't know what the advance was. As I said, I don't even remember any details of the…
Now Ramsey was working for the Harcourt at this time.
